border.note: Dark mode switches to translucent white oklch(1 0 0 / 10%).

ring.note: Always rendered at 50% opacity across a 3px spread.

destructive.note: The only chromatic token in the core palette.

surface-0.note: Project-defined tonal scale; identical in light and dark. Six real steps, not synthesized.

accent-orchid-1.note: Opt-in gradient stop 1 of 2; pairs with #4338ca at 115deg.

accent-nebula-1.note: Opt-in gradient stop 1 of 2; pairs with #6d28d9 at 115deg.

headline.purpose: Dialog titles. The largest type the system defines.

title.purpose: Card titles. Deliberately unsized - asserts weight only, inherits the consumer's base size.

body.purpose: Default UI text. Inputs step up to 1rem below the md breakpoint to prevent iOS zoom-on-focus.

typographyMeta._note: The system ships NO font-family token. Family is inherited from the consuming app; this is a recorded open gap, not a doctrine.

shadows.name: control
shadows.purpose: Buttons and inputs at rest (Tailwind shadow-xs). Separates an interactive element without implying it floats.

shadows.name: container
shadows.purpose: Cards and the active tab trigger (Tailwind shadow-sm). Marks a resting surface.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dialog content only (Tailwind shadow-lg). The one component allowed to look airborne.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Applied at 50% ring opacity on focus-visible across button, input, badge and tabs.

motion.name: overlay-enter
motion.purpose: Dialog fade plus 95% zoom, in and out.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.note: Dialog max-width caps at 32rem from here up.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.note: Input font-size steps down from 1rem to 0.875rem.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The filled default. Graphite fill, hover drops to 90% of its own fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 8px); background: var(--color-primary, oklch(0.205 0 0)); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, oklch(0.985 0 0)); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: background-color 0.15s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-primary, oklch(0.205 0 0)) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Hairline border on the page ground; fills with Whisper on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 8px); background: var(--color-background, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-accent, oklch(0.97 0 0)); color: var(--color-accent-foreground, oklch(0.205 0 0)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent at rest; resolves to the same Whisper hover as Secondary.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 8px); background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-accent, oklch(0.97 0 0)); color: var(--color-accent-foreground, oklch(0.205 0 0)); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Gradient Button
components.description: The opt-in accent path. Base class supplies direction and white text; the modifier sets only the two stops.
components.css: .ds-btn-gradient { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 8px); background-image: linear-gradient(115deg, var(--ds-grad-1), var(--ds-grad-2)); color: #fff; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-gradient:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-gradient:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-gradient-orchid { --ds-grad-1: #a21caf; --ds-grad-2: #4338ca; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Transparent ground, hairline border, border shifts to Ring on focus alongside the 3px ring.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-input, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 8px); background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font-size: 0.875rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--color-destructive, oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325)); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Full pill. Filled variants carry a transparent border so swapping to Outline shifts nothing.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; width: fit-content; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-primary, oklch(0.205 0 0)); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, oklch(0.985 0 0)); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; transition: color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-badge-secondary { background: var(--color-secondary, oklch(0.97 0 0)); color: var(--color-secondary-foreground, oklch(0.205 0 0)); } .ds-badge-outline { background: transparent; border-color: var(--color-border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); }

components.name: Card
components.description: The softest shape in the system at 14px. 24px inset held uniformly across every region.
components.html:
Monthly spend
Across all tracked accounts.
$1,284.00
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; padding: 24px 0; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: var(--radius-xl, 14px); background: var(--color-card, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--color-card-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-card-header { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 0 24px; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); } .ds-card-content { padding: 0 24px; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Muted track with 3px inset padding; the active trigger lifts to the page background.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: fit-content; height: 36px; padding: 3px; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 10px); background: var(--color-muted, oklch(0.97 0 0)); color: var(--color-muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); } .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; flex: 1; height: calc(100% - 1px); padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 8px); background: transparent; color: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-tab-active { background: var(--color-background, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: The only component granted real lift. Close icon inlined as SVG at 70% opacity.
components.html:
Delete project
This action cannot be undone.
components.css: .ds-dialog { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 16px; width: 100%; max-width: 32rem; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 10px); background: var(--color-background, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-dialog-title { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; } .ds-dialog-desc { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); } .ds-dialog-close { position: absolute; top: 16px; right: 16px; display: inline-flex; padding: 0; border: none; background: transparent; color: inherit; opacity: 0.7; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-dialog-close:hover { opacity: 1; }

narrative.overview:
This is a foundation, not a face. Every core token in the palette is chroma-zero - literally hueless - and that is the whole thesis. The registry is consumed by four separate applications (myargus, atto1, budget, erto-apps), and identity is something each of them adds on top, never something this layer imposes from below. A shared system that arrived with opinions about brand colour would force four apps to look like each other.

What it does own is rhythm and mechanics: a uniform 36px control height, a single radius variable everything else derives from, a consistent 3px focus ring, and hover states that shift opacity rather than swapping colour. The restraint is not minimalism for its own sake - it is what makes the layer safe to share. Colour is a guest here, not a resident.

Depth is the one place the system genuinely runs two mechanisms rather than one, and it does so deliberately: light-mode consumers get borders and hairline shadows, always-dark consumers get a six-step tonal ramp. Both express the same intent through the materials their mode actually has.
keyCharacteristics: Chroma-zero core; the only chromatic core token is destructive
One radius variable (--radius: 0.625rem) generates the entire corner scale
36px is the canonical control height across button, input, and tabs
Colour arrives only as signal, data, or an explicit consumer opt-in
No build step - components are copied into consumers and edited there

rules.name: The Guest Rule
rules.body: Colour is a guest, not a resident. The core palette is chroma-zero on purpose; any hue that appears must be carrying meaning - danger, a data series, or an accent a consumer deliberately chose.

rules.name: The Opt-In Accent Rule
rules.body: Choosing a gradient has no effect on the flat primary/accent tokens. The four candidates are additive utilities, not a brand decision made on the consumer's behalf. A consumer that picks none is in a fully supported state, not an unfinished one.

rules.name: The Two Systems Rule
rules.body: Never mix the mechanisms. A light-mode surface gains depth from a border and a hairline shadow; a dark-mode surface gains it from the next step up the ramp. Stacking both produces a muddy edge that reads as neither.

rules.name: The Overlay-Only Lift Rule
rules.body: shadow-lg belongs to the dialog. If a new component seems to need it, the real question is whether that component should be an overlay at all.

rules.name: The One Variable Rule
rules.body: Radius values are never hardcoded. If a component needs a corner, it takes a step off the scale - a literal px radius means the scale was wrong, not that the component is special.

dos: Do take every colour from a semantic token (bg-primary, text-muted-foreground). Both modes are defined; hardcoding a value breaks one of them.
Do derive corners from the radius scale so a change to --radius rescales the whole system.
Do keep interactive controls at 36px. Button, input, and tab list all agree on this height, and mixed heights in a row are immediately visible.
Do express hover as an opacity shift on the existing fill (/90, /80) rather than a different colour.
Do use focus-visible with the 3px ring at 50% opacity, so pointer users never see a ring that keyboard users depend on.
Do drive invalid state from aria-invalid, keeping the accessible attribute and the visual treatment inseparable.
Do pair every new component with a registry.json entry in the same commit - a source file the manifest does not list is unreachable.
donts: Don't introduce a brand hue into the core palette. Chroma-zero is the system's central commitment, and four consumers depend on supplying their own identity.
Don't treat the surface-* ramp as a light-mode tool. It holds the same values in both modes and only makes sense under an always-dark consumer.
Don't stack a tonal surface step and a shadow on the same element - pick the mechanism that belongs to the mode.
Don't reach for shadow-lg outside an overlay.
Don't add a font-family token casually. The absence is an unresolved gap affecting four applications, not a slot to fill in passing.
Don't assume choosing a gradient accent changes anything else. The gradients are additive utilities and leave the flat tokens untouched.
Don't hardcode white or black. #ffffff appears exactly twice by design - destructive button text and the gradient button - and both are fixed-fill cases.
